task.problem_statement: OpenQAOA users need to supply custom mixer circuits as rotation-gate maps rather than being limited to a mixer Hamiltonian. Both representations should describe consistent QAOA layers and coefficient assignments.
requirements: Accept a Hamiltonian or a list of rotation-gate maps as the mixer block.
Associate user-supplied mixer coefficients with gate maps and reject a mismatched number of coefficients.
Preserve the separation and ordering of single-qubit and two-qubit mixer terms across QAOA layers.
Produce equivalent circuit-parameter attributes for equivalent Hamiltonian and gate-map mixer inputs.

interface.Name: QAOACircuitParams
interface.Description: Provides QAOA layer blocks, mixer coefficients, and single/pair coefficient and gate-name attributes.

interface.Name: RXGateMap
interface.Description: Represents a single-qubit X rotation in a custom mixer.

interface.Name: RXXGateMap
interface.Description: Represents a two-qubit XX rotation in a custom mixer.
